elements.description: Plots one or more observed signals over time. Observes completed causal steps without changing the model. Double-click opens the full viewer. Channel bindings are prepared at run start; rewiring applies to the next run. Connect an output to the '+' port to add a channel. Inputs are numbered from zero.

input_ports.name: signal0, signal1, ...
input_ports.description: Observed real-valued outputs; '+' adds another input

parameters.name: channel_count
parameters.description: Number of signal inputs, maintained when wiring the '+' port. Nonnegative; initially no channels. Live acquisition supports up to 8 connected channels.

parameters.name: channel_names
parameters.description: Optional array of channel-name strings in input order, e.g. ["voltage","current"]. Missing/non-string entries use signal0, signal1, ... . Use distinct nonempty names for channel identity.

parameters.name: channel_units
parameters.description: Optional array of unit-label strings in input order, e.g. ["V","A"]. Labels do not convert values. Missing/non-string entries inherit a named signal tap's unit, otherwise the unit is unspecified.

elements.description: Bounded time window; adjustable retention and exact sample inspection. Does not record the full run. Observes completed causal steps without changing the model. parameters.description: Optional array of channel-name strings in input order, e.g. ["voltage","current"]. Missing/non-string entries use signal0, signal1, ... . Use distinct nonempty names for channel identity.

parameters.name: trigger
parameters.description: Optional saved trigger preset; omitted fields use the defaults shown below. mode: string rolling/auto/normal/single (default rolling); channel: zero-based integer 0..7 (default 0), must name a connected channel; edge: string rising/falling (default rising); level: finite number in raw channel units (default 0); hysteresis: finite nonnegative width in the same units (default 0), with representable finite level +/- width/2; pretrigger_percent: integer 0..100 (default 25); holdoff_steps: integer 0..1000000000 model steps (default 0); auto_timeout_steps: integer 1..1000000000 model steps (default 4096). Rolling ignores triggering; Auto can publish an untriggered frame after its timeout; Normal waits for an edge; Single holds a capture until rearmed. Invalid saved presets are reported and ignored. Display gain/offset do not change trigger measurements. Trigger edits in the live viewer apply immediately and are saved with the diagram.
